title: data-objectstack docs page documents an ObjectStackProvider / useObjectStack React API the package does not export (the package is headless)
body:
Out-of-scope finding from #3781 (dependency-contract prose on the same page). The maintainer ruling on that card scoped it to the three peer-dependency sites, so this is filed rather than fixed there.

## Fact (verified on `origin/main` = `cfeb378b5`)

`content/docs/utilities/data-objectstack.mdx` documents a React context provider and a hook that `@object-ui/data-objectstack` does not export:

| Doc site | Documented symbol | Reality |
|---|---|---|
| `:39` Quick Start "1. Setup Provider" | `ObjectStackProvider` | not exported |
| `:105` API Reference | `ObjectStackProvider` (props `apiUrl`, `apiKey`, `organizationId`, `children`) | not exported |
| `:142` API Reference | `useObjectStack` | not exported |

What `packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` actually exports: `ObjectStackAdapter` (class), `createObjectStackAdapter`, `MalformedFilterError`, `AnalyticsNotInstalledError`, `AnalyticsQueryRejectedError`, `ConcurrentUpdateError`, `serializeOrderBy`, `normaliseClientError`, `clearSharedDiscoveryCache`, `CloudOperations`, plus types. No provider, no hook.

## The package is headless — it cannot have a React provider

- `react` appears in **no** dependency field of `packages/data-objectstack/package.json` (only in `keywords`).
- `grep -rn react packages/data-objectstack/src/` returns two prose comments that mention the **separate** `@object-ui/react` package, and nothing else. Zero React imports.
- Its whole dependency closure is React-free: `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/types` both declare `peerDependencies: {}` and neither depends on react.

So this is not "an export that moved" — the documented shape has no home in this package.

## Impact

A reader following the Quick Start writes `import { ObjectStackProvider } from '@object-ui/data-objectstack'` and the import does not resolve. The `apiUrl` / `apiKey` / `organizationId` props and the `REACT_APP_OBJECTSTACK_*` environment variables at `:328` and `:346` belong to the same phantom shape.

## Fix direction (not pre-judged)

Rewrite the Quick Start and API Reference sections against the real surface (`createObjectStackAdapter` / `ObjectStackAdapter`, wired through the renderer's `dataSource` per Commandment #1), or point them at the package that genuinely owns provider-shaped APIs. Sizing that rewrite is a judgement call, hence a card rather than a drive-by edit.

## Searched for duplicates

`ObjectStackProvider useObjectStack docs`, `data-objectstack docs API reference`, `documented API does not exist phantom exports` over open issues in this repo: zero relevant hits (#2731 is an unrelated design card).
